culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Minoru Furuhashi. He used the projector to create his alibi. First, he asked Yuriko to buy tea for him so she wouldn’t be there at the time of the murder. Then, he adjusted the air conditioner so that the corpse would be swinging as if he had just died.

motive.quote: Then, he adjusted the air conditioner so that the corpse would be swinging as if he had just died.

method.quote: He used the projector to create his alibi.

evidence.quote: The evidence is in Toshiyuki‘s camera.

method.zhHans: 他利用放映机为自己制造不在场证明。之后，他开始实施镜面错觉的诡计：他用镜子把原本从左窗射入的光（他吊起被害人的那扇窗）改为从右窗投射出去。布置好这套镜面错觉后，他下到放映厅杀死 Seiji，趁影片正从另一扇窗放映时把尸体吊在左窗之前。这样一来，即使影子出现，他也会和 Yuriko 待在同一间房里，从而保住自己的不在场证明。
method.en: He used the projector to create his alibi. After that, he began the mirror illusion trick. He used mirrors so that the light coming from the left window, which was where he hung the victim, would instead be projected from the right window. After setting that mirror illusion, he went down to the theater, killed Seiji, and hung him in front of the left window while the movie was playing from the other window. That way, even when the shadow appeared, he and Yuriko would be in the same room together and would sustain his alibi.

evidence.zhHans: 证据在 Toshiyuki 的相机里。
evidence.en: The evidence is in Toshiyuki‘s camera.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Minoru Furuhashi。他利用放映机为自己制造不在场证明。首先，他请 Yuriko 去替他买茶，好让她在案发时不在场。接着，他调整空调，使尸体看起来像刚断气那样摇晃。
resolution.en: The culprit is Minoru Furuhashi. He used the projector to create his alibi. First, he asked Yuriko to buy tea for him so she wouldn’t be there at the time of the murder. Then, he adjusted the air conditioner so that the corpse would be swinging as if he had just died.

l3Absent.reason: 原文只叙述不在场证明的制造过程，未给出动机
